title: EventIdentity
description: The creative brief. Inference is expected and generous. Carries no operational data.

creativeDirection.description: Concise 1-3 sentence creative thesis. No renderer implementation choices.

toneKeywords.description: Ranked/curated tone adjectives or short phrases with minimal synonym redundancy.

colorsExplicitlyConstrained.description: True only when the host explicitly narrows/requires/excludes palette families.

requiredColors.description: Hard color requirements in short natural language; preserve exact user hex strings.

avoidColors.description: Explicit color exclusions. An exclusion is absolute and covers near neighbours.

dominanceNotes.description: How palette families should dominate/recede; empty string when unspecified.

toneExplicitlyConstrained.description: True only when the host explicitly constrains light/mid/dark tonal space.

compatibleTonalDirections.description: Ranked best-first compatible tonal directions. Do not pad with incompatible values.

compatibleFamilies.description: Ranked best-first compatible design families. A family is a compositional character.

compatibleTypographyCategories.description: Ranked compatible broad typography categories, not a font choice.

visualMotifs.description: Natural-language motif ideas, not renderer motif IDs.

textureDirection.description: Tactile/visual texture character. Never an image asset.

typographyDirection.description: Typographic character/hierarchy, not a raw font-family choice.

hostConstraints.description: AUTHORITATIVE, and narrow. A prohibition, an explicit requirement of a specific thing, or a correction the host made — grounded in an explicit phrase from their own words and kept verbatim or near-verbatim. Positive style direction is NOT a constraint: a named aesthetic or a tone adjective the host wants shapes the brief itself (creativeDirection, toneKeywords, palette), which is where later stages read it. If interpretation was needed to get here it is creativeGuidance. Empty is the common and correct answer.

creativeGuidance.description: ADVISORY. Your own creative recommendations. Later design stages may reconsider, override or evolve any of these when they find something better. This is where your taste belongs — never in hostConstraints.

inspirationSummary.description: Compact summary of inspiration evidence; exactly 'No visual inspiration supplied.' when none exists.

$comment: The creative brief as of event_identity_schema_v5. Operational event data is never carried here; it lives in the result envelope's `suppliedFacts` sibling (spec.md §7.5).
